name: computed-label-branches
source:
On 0 Gosub one,two : Print 0
On 2 Gosub one,two : Print 3
On 1 Goto done
Print 99
End
one: Print 1 : Return
two: Print 2 : Return
done: Print 4 : End

encoding.notes: Literal original token words: On=0316 plus two metadata words, Gosub=02b2, Goto=02a8, Return=0360, End=03b6, Print=0476. Physical lines and label payloads assembled separately without a production encoder/table.

evidence.notes: Original interpreter uses one-based selection, falls through for zero/out-of-range selectors, and saves the continuation only for a selected Gosub. This is source analysis, not an AMOS execution capture.
